collection.title: Citroen C15 1984 to 1997 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C15 1984 to 1997 model requires an 18" wiper blade and the following blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
